converter.readUp: Read the remainders from bottom to top.

twos.title: 2's complement
twos.step1Neg: Write the binary form of {{n}} (ignore the minus sign).
twos.step1Pos: {{n}} is positive, so its 2's complement is the same as its binary form.
twos.step2Body: Change each 0 to 1 and each 1 to 0. This is the 1's complement. Flipped bits are highlighted.
twos.step3Body: Add 1 to the 1's complement. A carry moves left until it meets a 0.
twos.check: Check: the leftmost bit counts as −{{w}}, the others add up normally.

arith.addIntro: Add column by column from the right. 1 + 1 = 10, so write 0 and carry 1.
arith.subIntro: To compute A − B, find the 2's complement of B (that is −B), then add it to A.
arith.negB: Add 1 to the flipped bits. The result is −B.
arith.carryOut: The carry out of the leftmost column ({{c}}) is discarded.
arith.overflow: Overflow: the true answer {{value}} does not fit in {{bits}} bits, so these bits show a wrong number.
arith.noOverflow: No overflow: the answer fits in {{bits}} bits.

logic.circuitLabel: Logic circuit. Green wires carry 1, grey wires carry 0.
logic.tapHint: Tap an input to switch it between 0 and 1.

desc.AND: Output is 1 only when every input is 1.
desc.OR: Output is 1 when at least one input is 1.
desc.NOT: Output is the opposite of the input.
desc.NAND: AND followed by NOT. Output is 0 only when every input is 1.
desc.NOR: OR followed by NOT. Output is 1 only when every input is 0.
desc.XOR: Output is 1 when the two inputs are different.
desc.XNOR: Output is 1 when the two inputs are the same.

universal.intro: NAND and NOR are universal gates: every other gate can be built from just one of them.
universal.matches: On every row, this circuit gives the same output as a real {{gate}} gate.

how.NAND_NOT: Join both inputs of a NAND together. It now just inverts the signal.
how.NAND_AND: A NAND gives NOT-AND. A second NAND wired as a NOT flips it back to AND.
how.NAND_OR: Invert A and B with two NANDs wired as NOTs, then NAND the results. By De Morgan's law this gives A OR B.
how.NOR_NOT: Join both inputs of a NOR together. It now just inverts the signal.
how.NOR_OR: A NOR gives NOT-OR. A second NOR wired as a NOT flips it back to OR.
how.NOR_AND: Invert A and B with two NORs wired as NOTs, then NOR the results. By De Morgan's law this gives A AND B.

adders.halfNote: Sum = A XOR B. Carry = A AND B.
adders.fullNote: Sum = A XOR B XOR Cin. Cout = A·B + Cin·(A XOR B).
adders.halfTotal: {{a}} + {{b}} = {{value}} in binary, so Sum is {{sum}} and Carry is {{carry}}.
adders.fullTotal: {{a}} + {{b}} + {{c}} = {{value}} in binary, so Sum is {{sum}} and Cout is {{carry}}.

encdec.decoderHint: Tap the input bits. Exactly one output line turns on.
encdec.encoderHint: Tap one input line. The outputs show its number in binary.
encdec.decoderResult: Input {{bits}} is {{n}}, so output D{{n}} is on.
encdec.encoderResult: Input I{{n}} is on, so the output is {{bits}}.
encdec.noInput: No input line is on, so the output is {{bits}}.
